resources.string: Photos stay on this phone. They are included in shopping-data exports and device transfers, but are not shared or synced.
Reading sends this prepared photo to your configured image-capable model, directly or through your Usuals server. Nothing is sent until you tap Read.
Check the date, names and amounts. Edit or remove lines before saving. Prices, totals and taxes are not purchases.
No purchased items were found. Enter them yourself or try another photo.
The selected list or shop has changed. Reopen the receipt from History.
Could not save the receipt. Your draft is still here. Try again.
Could not open this app. Choose your wallet app again in Favourites, Shopping preferences.
Could not read the receipt with your model. The photo is still here. Enter the items yourself or try again.
